lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a horizontal linear pattern along the visible posterior flank and extending onto the caudal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical transition from darker pixels above to lighter pixels below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible indentation or notch on the ventral margin of the caudal peduncle, specifically highlighted by an artificial white arrow graphic.
